# JUDO Expression Metamodel

> Defines the EMF metamodel for type-safe expressions in the JUDO framework — covering numeric, string, logical, temporal, collection, enumeration, and custom expression types — with runtime utilities for evaluation, validation, and model manipulation.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.9+ with Eclipse Tycho 4.0.13
- Multi-module Maven project, 11 modules (3 core, 2 test, 3 Eclipse features, 1 OSGi bundle, 1 P2 site)
- Core technologies: Eclipse EMF, Epsilon EVL, Xtext, MWE2, OSGi
- Dual-packaged as Eclipse plugins and standalone OSGi bundle
- External metamodel dependencies: judo-meta-measure, judo-meta-jql
- License: Eclipse Public License 2.0 (EPL-2.0)

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview, module diagram, expression type hierarchy, and quick start
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with directory structure, build commands, technology stack, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines, code style, dependency rules, and build verification
- [.github/CIFLOW.md](.github/CIFLOW.md): CI/CD pipeline and branching strategy

## Modules — Core

- [model/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF](model/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF): Core EMF metamodel (expression.ecore), generated Java classes, runtime utilities (ExpressionUtils, ExpressionEvaluator, ExpressionValidator), and Epsilon EVL validations
- [adapter-measure/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF](adapter-measure/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF): Measure/unit adapter — resolves measures and units for numeric expressions, calculates dimensions, handles unit conversion and temporal duration measures
- [builder-jql/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF](builder-jql/META-INF/MANIFEST.MF): JQL (JUDO Query Language) to Expression transformer — 55+ function transformers converting JQL ASTs into Expression metamodel instances

## Modules — Testing

- [model-test/pom.xml](model-test/pom.xml): JUnit 5 unit tests for the core model, measure adapter, and measure change handling
- [osgi-itest/pom.xml](osgi-itest/pom.xml): OSGi integration tests using PAX Exam on Apache Karaf — verifies bundle activation and service registration

## Modules — OSGi & Packaging

- [osgi/pom.xml](osgi/pom.xml): Standalone OSGi bundle with bundle tracker for dynamic expression model loading
- [feature-model/feature.xml](feature-model/feature.xml): Eclipse feature for the core model plugin
- [feature-adapter-measure/feature.xml](feature-adapter-measure/feature.xml): Eclipse feature for the measure adapter plugin
- [feature-builder-jql/feature.xml](feature-builder-jql/feature.xml): Eclipse feature for the JQL builder plugin
- [site/pom.xml](site/pom.xml): P2 update site aggregating all Eclipse features

## Optional

- [.github/workflows/build.yml](.github/workflows/build.yml): CI/CD build pipeline
- [model/model/expression.ecore](model/model/expression.ecore): Core EMF metamodel definition (12 subpackages, 31+ EClasses)
- [model/model/expression.genmodel](model/model/expression.genmodel): EMF code generation model
